item.title: 0.1.0-rc.2
item.description: • macOS: sign ad-hoc releases without the hardened runtime

item.title: 0.1.0-rc.1
item.description:
• Clear the build warnings from CI
  • Hide the shortcut tooltip
  • Stop the wheel changing drop-downs
  • Windows: attach the title bar and update handlers after the fields they use are assigned
  • Bump the nuget group with 4 updates
  • Bump actions/setup-dotnet from 5.4.0 to 6.0.0 in the actions group
  • Kit: Retry now waits out a system fetch in flight, stop() drops late state, steadier stale-connection test
  • CI: the p8ctl smoke test expects the health and monitoring files in a capture
  • macOS: every word from the catalog, a Language picker, and the pre-release setting
  • Kit: an update setting for pre-releases, and the text the macOS app needs
  • Release versioning from the tag, with pre-release channels
  • Windows: restart the matrix, cloud link on Health, logo with transparent corners
  • macOS: new app icon artwork
  • Windows: add the app logo
  • Show the matrix's cloud link on the Health page
  • macOS: lay the Hardware page out as topics, like the Windows app
  • macOS: centre the controls in the Settings and port editor rows
  • Restart the matrix, with a confirmation, as an admin-only action
  • Windows: several matrices, health, Hardware topics, About page
  • Xcode: run the PulseEightControl scheme in Release
  • macOS: Connections list, health page, local network permission, connection grace
  • macOS: fix the window half redrawn when the theme is set to System
  • Kit: several matrices, real-device decoding, health report, connection recovery
  • macOS: build with the hardened runtime on
  • macOS: Find Matrix in Settings and on the no-matrix screen
  • Core: discoverMatrix and a discover command for the C interface
  • Find the matrix through gotomymatrix.com's redirect
  • Release workflow: name the published release after the tag that started the run
  • Release workflow: use the secret's real name; fail a build that lacks the update address or key
  • Release workflow: give the macOS build a feed address only together with the key
  • smoke.ps1: treat an empty fake-matrix log as no output yet
  • Fix what the first CI run found
  • Windows: Inno Setup installer, release-build parameters, and the Windows half of the release workflow
  • Windows app: update dialog, daily check and an Updates section in Settings
  • Windows updates: turn feed release notes (HTML) into plain text for the dialog
  • Windows: PulseEight.Updates, the updater without any UI
  • Windows core client: the update-check setting (snapshot field, typed command, tests)
  • Core: a setting for whether the app checks for updates by itself
  • Add the release tooling and a verified end-to-end macOS update test
  • macOS: add Sparkle for automatic updates
  • Add the CI workflow, Dependabot config and a pin checker
  • Add the new test suites to the VS Code tasks and README
  • Add a coverage summary script for CI job pages
  • Windows: more core tests, a free port for the fake, and an app smoke test
  • Add a smoke test of p8ctl against p8fake over a real socket
  • Add tests for the macOS app's model and its flows
  • Stop the core's polling on destroy, and test the C interface from Swift
  • Harden secrets and settings, and add the tests they never had
  • Fix MatrixStore writing a stale poll's answer after stop or reconfigure
  • Add p8ctl capture and tests that decode real device responses
  • Fix the fake server serving a later server's clients after stop()
  • Keep LF line endings for shell scripts
  • Add VS Code tasks and launch configs, Windows test script, README
  • Add the Xcode project, workspace schemes and packaging script
  • macOS app: native SwiftUI instead of SwiftCrossUI
  • Shorter build paths: one out/ folder for all Windows build output
  • Windows app: use the shared string catalog, add a language picker
  • Add localisation to the core: shared string catalog, language setting
  • Replace the Python fake matrix with a Swift one (PulseEightFakeServer)
  • Restructure the repository into clearly named folders
  • Windows UI: centred two-column pages, title bar, theming, route icons
  • Fix Windows app startup: add a minimal App.xaml
  • Use WinHTTP for matrix requests on Windows
  • Add the Windows app: C# WinUI 3 over the shared core
  • Make the SwiftCrossUI app macOS-only on top of PulseEightCore
  • Add PulseEightCore: shared app logic with a C interface
  • Add P8_BISECT diagnostic switch for backend crash hunting
  • Guard layout against non-finite sizes for WinUI; fix spike manifest
  • Choose macOS-only package pieces by host OS, not platform conditions
  • Fix non-macOS Settings window build
  • Fix all compiler warnings flagged in Xcode
  • Unload inactive pages instead of hiding them; slim grid tiles
  • Embed an Info.plist in the executable for app identity
  • Native SwiftUI Settings window; faster tab switching
  • Move Settings to its own window; highlight the grid cells directly
  • Refine macOS UI: Liquid Glass, grid, status bar, menus
  • Make the macOS app look and behave natively
  • Add Hardware view and admin features (M4)
  • Add native app: shell (M2) and routing grid (M3)
  • Add fake NeoMatrix dev server
  • Add SwiftCrossUI M0 spike and findings
  • Add PulseEightKit: native Swift device layer and p8ctl CLI
  • Initial commit
